messages:
Maddie: FYI I rolled kernel-selector v2.3 to staging at 09:12 and I'm seeing a ~8-12% drop in prefix cache hit rate vs yesterday, plus a couple of GPU OOMs on small nodes. Anyone else? :eyes:
perfbot: perf/regression check: model=redwood-small, metric=prefix_hitrate, delta=-0.098, p90_latency=+11ms
Josh: ugh. Was that the kernel fallback jitter change? I thought that only touched batch scheduling.
Maddie: It touched kernel scoring; selector now prefers lower-latency kernels more aggressively which increases fragmentation of KV placements. Hypothesis: more frequent kernel switches produce smaller contiguous slabs -> lower hit-rate.
Priya: Interesting. Can you paste a quick heatmap or sample of KV slab allocation?
Maddie: here's a tiny dump from staging sampler (top keys by slab id):
```
slab-0: keys=12, avg-prefix-len=34, hit=0.62
slab-1: keys=3, avg-prefix-len=120, hit=0.12
slab-8: keys=48, avg-prefix-len=16, hit=0.78
slab-12: keys=1, avg-prefix-len=200, hit=0.05
```
Maddie: you can see skinny slabs with huge prefixes that rarely hit -> fragmentation.
Taylor: That matches the fragmentation hotspots we saw in the 184* experiments but not identical. This one smells like allocation churn from kernel switching during long contexts.
Josh: Any quick repro curl we can run locally to reproduce hit-rate drop?
Maddie: Yep, run the staging sim:
```
export TARGET=staging
./tools/prompt_profile.py --model redwood-small --threads 32 --walk file://samp/prefixes_hot.json --duration 120 --collect-kv-stats
```
Priya: I ran that for 2 mins. Confirming hit-rate -9% and a couple of small-allocation OOMs. Putting numbers in Datadog: `env:staging, tag:kernel=v2.3`.
perfbot: profile artifact uploaded: s3://perf-artifacts/1975432100/kernel-frag-19754321.tar.gz
Maddie: Proposed short-term mitigations: (1) soften kernel switch weight (score_decay from 0.8->0.6), (2) introduce a soft-evict window for recently-warmed slabs (hold TTL_incr for 30s), (3) increase small-node KV reserve by 12%. Suggest we A/B the score_decay first.
Taylor: Fine by me. Score decay tweak sounds low-risk. If that doesn't recover hit-rate we can try soft-evict window.
Josh: Quick concern: soft-evict window may increase memory amplification and raise OOM risk under heavy churn. We'll need safety gating and metric alarms.
Priya: I can add a temporary guard: if mem_pressure>0.85 then bypass soft-evict window and fallback to aggressive eviction. Want to push a config flag `runtime.kernel_frag_guard=true` to staging.
Maddie: Please do. Also let's add a small experiment: pin kernel selector to v2.2 on a subset of staging nodes and compare heatmaps for 1 hour.
infra-bot: Deployed config `runtime.kernel_frag_guard=true` to staging-canary-2 at 09:36.
Josh: I'll prepare the A/B: 50% nodes on v2.2, 50% on v2.3 with score_decay=0.6 and collect KV slab histograms every 30s.
perfbot: experiment scheduled: exp_id=frag-mitigation-19754321, duration=60m, metrics=[prefix_hitrate, kv_slab_count, mem_pressure, p90_latency]
Maddie: If we see hit-rate recover to within 2% of baseline and no latency regressions, we can roll change to production for kernel scoring only.
Taylor: Add a perf regression alert if p90_latency > baseline + 20ms or mem_pressure > 0.9 for >2mins.
Priya: I'll add the alert and a dashboard panel showing per-slab hit-rate distribution and largest-prefix-per-slab.
Josh: After A/B finishes I'll post the heatmap and a diff of slab-size percentiles.
Maddie: Also note: we should long-term consider a compaction pass that re-packs small-high-prefix slabs during low-traffic windows to reduce fragmentation. Filing a ticket after this triage.
Maddie: Action items: Josh set up A/B (doing), Priya add alert + guard (doing), Taylor draft compaction spec (todo), Maddie follow-up with rollout plan (todo). :thumbsup:
perfbot: exp-results snapshot will be auto-posted at 10:36 to this thread.
Josh: Started the AB at 09:42.
Priya: Guard and alert in, and I added `kv.reserve_small_nodes = 12%` as a rapid fallback.
Maddie: Thanks team. Ping here with heatmaps. If anyone sees prod noise, drop an incident.
Taylor: noted. Will write the compaction proposal after we have numbers.
perfbot: experiment finished: prefix_hitrate diff: v2.3(-0.09) vs v2.2(-0.01). mem_pressure slightly higher on v2.3. Full artifact: s3://perf-artifacts/1975432100/frag-mitigation-results.json
Maddie: Ok. Looks like score_decay tweak wasn't enough. Next step: enable soft-evict window for canary and rerun.
Josh: I'll schedule that after lunch.
Priya: Leaving here a quick snippet for the soft-evict config if helpful:
```
runtime:
  kv_cache:
    soft_evict_window_seconds: 30
    hold_on_warm: true
    aggressive_when_mem>0.9: true
```
Maddie: Nice. Thanks. We'll coordinate next steps in the follow-up ticket. :pray:
